scope: Favorite outline cache reuse after a controller is recreated in the same browser process

realIcons.note: Compact selection opacity is still zero synchronously and one at the first requested animation frame. Similar deferred opacity exists in R84 evidence; this change addresses cache preparation only.

limits: Timings measure controller request to ready, not physical click-to-paint.
Two controller lifetimes use the real window Image decoder and Core Image renderer; this is not a whole-browser benchmark.
Cold artwork rendering, compact selection attribute timing and first 650 ms of Arc site-search flash remain separate open checks.
Strict config check reports pre-existing SC2034 warnings in unchanged SketchyBar scripts.
